crossRefs.note: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their…
But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience…
I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good…
But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my…
Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

translations.web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
translations.bsb: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
translations.kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help
